description: IPC for the start screen (local asset origin) AND the live backend UI this window navigates to once started (http://127.0.0.1/localhost, any port -- PORT is operator-configurable in .env). Real, confirmed incident this fixes: without the "remote" block below, a capability only ever applies to the window's ORIGINAL local asset content -- once main.rs's own window.navigate() moves this same window to the live http:// backend (every ordinary use of the app past the start screen), Tauri's own ACL treated that as unauthorized remote content and silently rejected every command call from it ("Command <name> not allowed by ACL", surfaced nowhere but the JS invoke() promise's own rejection) -- including open_external_url (Codex/Copilot OAuth "Connect", a Library source's own link, "Get a key" links) and notify_session_done, both called only from THIS post-navigation UI, never the start screen.
